binary_known_truth.rule: contradicted flags an error; supported/unknown do not; invalid responses excluded and reported

metrics.limitations: Synthetic closed-world inputs, real model calls. Unknown truth excluded from binary denominators. Not AEE detector precision/recall, workflow hallucination prevalence or treatment efficacy.

limits: Twelve synthetic closed-world factbooks, four cases per truth category; a convenience diagnostic, not spontaneous workflow hallucination prevalence.

Two factbooks were corrected after observing original v1 responses: case09 removed the finished=false presupposition conflict; case11 removed an explicitly wrong known reference from an incomplete inventory. Original labels, claims, other10 cases and oracle remain unchanged; original v1 results stay published.

This corrective rerun is not an independent replication or a causal AEE benefit estimate. AEE was not the factbook verdict detector. No AEE precision/recall, whole-workflow hallucination rate or universal zero-hallucination claim follows.
Only the benchmark client route changed to the same existing worker with process/port/model/path guards. Historical underlying router socket failure remains unresolved.
API spend0 excludes hardware, energy and labor; tokens are not bills. Diagnostic output256 differs from main study output8192 and is reported separately.
